purpose: Compact pressure fixtures for checking that platform and product jobs change the information architecture.

benchmarks.brief: Build an iPhone and Android camera utility that captures a useful image and lets the user recover from denied access.
benchmarks.primary_job: Frame and capture a meaningful image or video
benchmarks.navigation: Immersive preview with contextual settings and a lightweight review flow; no persistent generic tab shell.
benchmarks.primary_surface: Live camera preview with thumb-reachable capture, flip, flash, and review controls.
benchmarks.visual_direction: Dark optical utility: the preview owns contrast, controls are quiet until needed, and capture feedback uses a single high-signal accent.
component_variants: review action bar: retake / save / share

visual_fidelity.evidence: Benchmark fixture only; no native runtime is claimed.

review_findings.evidence: Native camera permission and interruption behavior are not rendered in this fixture.
review_findings.next_action: Render denied, unavailable, orientation, and interruption states on both declared devices.

benchmarks.brief: Build a mobile camera game that recognizes a physical object and rewards a successful result.
benchmarks.primary_job: Frame the challenge, complete the interaction, and understand the result or retry.
benchmarks.navigation: Contextual progression from permission → challenge → live play → result; system back pauses or confirms exit.
benchmarks.primary_surface: Camera/game canvas with HUD, target guidance, score, pause, and thumb-zone action controls.
benchmarks.visual_direction: Kinetic arcade: bold score typography, restrained HUD layers, clear target silhouette, and motion used for feedback rather than decoration.
avoid: bottom navigation competing with the canvas
decorative chrome above the live target

visual_fidelity.evidence: Benchmark fixture only; no native runtime is claimed.

review_findings.evidence: Camera/game interruption and orientation states still need device rendering.
review_findings.next_action: Run the full play loop on both platforms with camera denial, pause, rotate, fail, and reward evidence.

benchmarks.brief: Design a responsive SaaS operations dashboard for a team monitoring weekly work, exceptions, and exports.
benchmarks.primary_job: Scope the operation, inspect exceptions, and take a confident next action.
benchmarks.navigation: Workspace rail plus URL-addressable views; filters and table scope stay visible, while narrow layouts move secondary navigation into a drawer.
benchmarks.primary_surface: Data-dense overview with date range, team scope, exception table, drill-down drawer, and export action.
benchmarks.visual_direction: Quiet operations: high-contrast data hierarchy, measured density, restrained status color, and generous whitespace around decisions rather than cards everywhere.
avoid: shrinking desktop tables until they are unreadable

visual_fidelity.evidence: Benchmark fixture only; no dashboard runtime is claimed.

review_findings.evidence: Dense table wrapping, keyboard scope changes, and narrow export recovery need rendered checks.
review_findings.next_action: Render long labels, empty scope, stale data, keyboard focus, and 1024/390 breakpoint evidence.

benchmarks.brief: Design a cross-platform messaging product where people can resume a conversation, send media, and recover failed messages.
benchmarks.primary_job: Exchange messages while keeping conversation context and delivery state clear.
benchmarks.navigation: Conversation list → thread; back returns to the list, deep links open a thread, and composer actions stay contextual to the active thread.
benchmarks.primary_surface: Thread timeline with reply composer, attachment affordance, delivery/read state, and retry action.
benchmarks.visual_direction: Tactile signal: calm thread canvas, distinct message grouping, one accent for unread/new, and motion only for send/retry feedback.
avoid: feed-style post cards inside the thread
generic navigation that hides back and keyboard behavior

visual_fidelity.evidence: Benchmark fixture only; no messaging runtime is claimed.

review_findings.evidence: Keyboard movement, back behavior, and failed-send recovery are not rendered in this fixture.
review_findings.next_action: Render keyboard, screen reader order, offline, retry, attachment denial, and native back/sheet behavior per platform.
